fields.description: The attempt this answer belongs to.
fields.label: Attempt

fields.description: Which version was being taken. Answers are only comparable within a version — a material change can rewrite the question underneath them.
fields.label: Course Version

fields.description: The learner, copied from the attempt so this table can be reported on without joining.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Whether this was asked by a lesson quiz or by a checkpoint partway through a video.
fields.label: Asked By

fields.description: The question from the pool, when this came from a quiz.
fields.label: Question

fields.description: The checkpoint, when this came from one. Per-checkpoint failure rates read off this field — a checkpoint most people miss usually means the video is unclear, not that the learners are.
fields.label: Checkpoint

fields.description: Which run of the lesson quiz this answer belongs to, counting from 1.
fields.label: Quiz Run

fields.description: The question as it read at the moment it was asked. Kept verbatim so a later edit to the question bank cannot change what an old answer appears to have been given to.
fields.label: Question Asked

fields.description: What the learner picked, as option keys or typed text. Never the correct answer — that stays on the server.
fields.label: Given Answer

fields.description: Graded on the server against the published answer key. Nothing the browser sends about correctness is read.
fields.label: Correct

fields.description: How long the learner spent on this one question. Useful for spotting a question everybody stalls on.
fields.label: Seconds Taken
